name: 115. Bedrock encrypted reasoning model switch
description: Regression for Codex switching from Luna to Terra in one conversation: Bedrock runtime rejects replayed encrypted reasoning with HTTP 400 / validation_error / "encrypted reasoning was created for a different account or model". Bifrost must recognize that refusal and retry once without the incompatible encrypted state. The producer captures real Luna output; both consumers independently replay that same history to Terra and require completed responses. A missing encrypted payload fails the producer, and the harness chained-variable guard fails dependent requests. Requires the existing bedrock_openai_ep provider (use_openai_endpoints: true) and access to both models; the default bedrock provider can route through Converse and would miss the reported endpoint.
